title: Create the OyeLoMex Cultural Library Roadmap
goal: Design a source-backed, balanced, practical roadmap for growing OyeLoMex into a major digital library for Mexican thought.
acceptanceCriteria: Research includes a balanced author/work shortlist across periods, regions, genres, Indigenous thought, women, and intellectual traditions.
Every factual recommendation has a source URL or is explicitly labeled as a proposal or uncertainty.
Rights analysis distinguishes author copyright from edition, translation, transcription, and recording rights.
Strategy defines a practical metadata model, catalog growth phases, and audio-production priorities.
Critic checks historical balance, rights risk, feasibility, and unsupported claims.
No public production files are changed during this roadmap task.
